key.name: caps-lock-switch-enabled
key.description: Use single press of Caps Lock to switch between keyboard layouts.

key.name: caps-lock-hold-enabled
key.summary: Enable layout lock by holding Caps Lock
key.description: Temporarily lock non-primary keyboard layout by holding Caps Lock key.

key.name: caps-lock-hold-duration
key.summary: Caps Lock hold duration in milliseconds
key.description: Duration in milliseconds Caps Lock must be held down to lock the layout.

key.name: auto-switch-enabled
key.description: Automatically switch back to the primary layout when the countdown finishes.

key.name: show-indicator
key.description: Whether to show the visual indicator bar on the screen.

key.name: timeout-seconds
key.description: Inactivity timeout in seconds before switching back to the primary layout.

key.name: bar-position
key.description: Edge or corners of the screen where indicator bars are placed: top, bottom, top-bottom, left, right, left-right, top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right, all-corners.

key.name: margin-top
key.description: Margin from the top screen edge in pixels.

key.name: margin-bottom
key.description: Margin from the bottom screen edge in pixels.

key.name: margin-left
key.description: Margin from the left screen edge in pixels.

key.name: margin-right
key.description: Margin from the right screen edge in pixels.

key.name: bar-margin
key.description: Fallback margin in pixels.

key.name: bar-thickness
key.description: Thickness of the indicator bar in pixels.

key.name: bar-length-fraction
key.description: Length of the indicator bar as a fraction of the screen edge dimension (0.05 to 1.0).

key.name: bar-color
key.description: CSS color string for the indicator bar (e.g. #3584e4, #ffffff, rgba(...)).

key.name: bar-radius
key.description: Border corner radius in pixels.

key.name: animation-mode
key.description: Indicator animation mode: to-center, to-start, to-end, to-edges (split from center), fill-from-center (expand from center), from-edges-to-center (converge to center).

key.name: fade-duration
key.description: Duration of smooth fade-in and fade-out animations in milliseconds (0 to disable).

key.name: split-fade-durations
key.description: Whether to configure separate timing for fade-in and fade-out.

key.name: fade-in-duration
key.description: Duration of smooth fade-in appearance in milliseconds.

key.name: fade-out-duration
key.description: Duration of smooth fade-out dissolution in milliseconds.

key.name: only-on-primary-monitor
key.description: Show the indicator bar only on the primary display.

key.name: switch-to-source-index
key.description: Input source index to activate upon timeout (default 0 is usually English/primary).
